title: Updates menu and page, topics and tags, AI covers, green hover light everywhere
changes: Header: BLOGS, GUIDES and NEWS are one UPDATES menu (Blogs, Guides, News, All updates); the menu no longer runs into the search box on smaller screens
/updates/: blogs, guides and news together, with filters by type, hardware (PC Hardware / Gaming Hardware), its category (graphics cards, mice ...), tag and a search
CMS editor (picture tab): topic = hardware group, then its category; tags (comma separated); they show under the post as links to the filtered Updates page
Posts without a picture get a cover made with AI (Cloudflare) when you publish; a "Make an AI cover now" button too
Blog writer: no approval step; it writes by itself until Monday 19 October, after that you write the posts (CMS > Blog writer > Automatic blog posts sets the date); news keeps running
Footer: two menu columns of the same width; POLICIES is now UPDATES & TERMS with Blogs, News and Guides
The green light that follows the mouse now works on every white card and box of the site, game pages included
steps: Upload the zip to /home2/runoncon/, unzip it, then run the installers listed in the deploy message.
